root.label: U.S. Marine arrested over alleged murder of woman in Okinawa

events.label: U.S. Marine arrested over alleged murder of woman in Okinawa
Tokyo protest against US military presence after Okinawa killing
Okinawa governor meets Japanese officials over Marine murder case

slots.name: meeting with defense minister
slots.sentence: Governor Genta Koja, in Tokyo for the first time since taking office last month, met with Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi to express outrage over the killing.

slots.name: disciplinary measure effectiveness
slots.sentence: “I must say past disciplinary measures and human rights education implemented by the U.S. military have not worked at all,” Koja said.
